caption: The drawing depicts a lavishly decorated theater box. On the left, there is a stage with peach-colored curtains featuring gold fringe and tassels, as well as the partial word "ASBESTOS" embroidered near the top. In front of the curtains, there is an ornate golden decorative stand holding a white sign bordered with blue and gold patterns, which reads "FAY TEMPLETON." In the bottom left of the image, there is a bouquet of pink flowers with green leaves laying on a gray surface. A dividing wall is heavily embellished with gold swirling leaf motifs and pastel blue and pink medallions. Within the box, there are rows of gold-colored chairs. The background wall has a dark blue or black floral pattern, and the alcoves are adorned with gold drapes that are tied back with tassels, flanked by white columns with gold detailing. On the wall at the back of the box, there is a framed sign with a green image and red text. Draped over the front of the balcony is a silver or white fur stole. Decorative white lamps or wheels with blue and gold accents are mounted above, integrated into the top border of the box. The overall composition is detailed with intricate designs and a warm color palette dominated by gold, peach, and dark blue, with touches of pastel colors in the decorative medallions.
title: Theatre Box, 1892
